items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25

ctx.x: Well we can get it another day if you got a little hunt for it. Yeah. Maybe we better get back to Dave if you think that's the size of it. Unless you want to tell us some of your favorite trombone players or clarinet players and guys on the different instruments from the old days that you listened to.

Well I can tell you the one. Well I can tell you the one. He's not one of the real old timers but he's one of the, he's more or less, plays that type of music better than any of the later musicians, is Alvin Alcorn.
